questions.def: Use the base form of the verb with 'they'.
questions.question: They ___ to the park every Sunday.

questions.def: Use past continuous for actions in progress in the past.
questions.question: She ___ a book when I called.

questions.def: 'He' requires 'doesn't', not 'don't'.
questions.question: He don't like to eat vegetables.

questions.def: Use present perfect for actions that started in the past.
questions.question: I ___ here for five years.

questions.def: Use 'were' in conditional sentences with 'I'.
questions.question: If I ___ you, I would study harder.

questions.def: Use 'where' to ask about a place.
questions.question: She asked me ___ I was going.

questions.def: Use the past simple tense for completed actions.
questions.question: He ___ dinner last night.

questions.def: Use 'is going' for future plans.
questions.question: She ___ to the party tomorrow.

questions.def: 'I' requires 'have' in present perfect tense.
questions.question: I ___ seen that movie before.

questions.def: Use simple past for completed action.
questions.question: He ___ all the cake.

questions.def: Use plural form 'were' with 'they'.
questions.question: They ___ happy when they won.

questions.def: 'Than' is used for comparisons.
questions.question: He is taller ___ me.

questions.def: 'I' takes the base form of the verb.
questions.question: I ___ to go home now.

questions.def: Use past tense 'was' to match 'said'.
questions.question: She said that she ___ busy.

questions.def: 'Already' shows that something is finished.
questions.question: He has ___ finished his work.

questions.def: Use 'do' to form questions in present simple with 'you'.
questions.question: Where ___ you live?

questions.def: Use 'Does' to form questions in present simple with 'he'.
questions.question: ___ he like to play football?

questions.def: Use 'any' in negative sentences.
questions.question: I don't have ___ money.

questions.def: Use the past simple tense for completed actions.
questions.question: She ___ to the store yesterday.

questions.def: Use 'is' with singular noun 'book'.
questions.question: The book ___ on the table.

questions.def: 'He' requires 'needs' in present simple.
questions.question: He ___ to finish the project on time.

questions.def: 'They' requires 'are', not 'is'.
questions.question: They is coming to our party.

questions.def: 'It' requires 'is' in the present simple.
questions.question: It ___ a nice day.

questions.def: Use 'were' with plural 'they' in past continuous.
questions.question: They ___ playing when it started raining.

questions.def: Use 'a' before consonant sounds.
questions.question: She is ___ student at the university.

questions.def: Use the past simple tense for completed actions in the past.
questions.question: They ___ to the cinema last night.

questions.def: Use 'be going to' to talk about future plans.
questions.question: He ___ a new car next month.

questions.def: 'She' takes 'doesn't', not 'don't'.
questions.question: She don't like to eat meat.

questions.def: Use present perfect for actions that started in the past and continue.
questions.question: I ___ in London for five years.

questions.def: Use 'were' in second conditional sentences, even for 'I'.
questions.question: If I ___ you, I would study harder.
